architectureDecisions: D1 — DELIVER_SLICE_V1 (export DELIVER_SLICE_VERSION) = { id, repositoryRoot, baseRevision, prompt, tool, backendVerifications, qaVerifications, requiredFiles?, recoveryDir?, maxAttempts?, timeoutMs? }. validateDeliverSlice rejects missing id/repositoryRoot/40-hex baseRevision/prompt/tool (codex|kiro|agy only)/non-empty backendVerifications and qaVerifications arrays of { name, command, args, timeoutMs }. Extra fields ignored. commandDeliver(options) reads options.slice JSON; missing --slice throws without spawning. CLI: exharness-agent deliver --slice <file> [--command <path>] [--recovery-dir <dir>].

D2 — runDeliverSlice maps backendVerifications (+ optional requiredFiles) to AGENT_TASK_V1 and calls runSupervisedTask({ tool, task, recoveryDir, maxAttempts, timeoutMs, env, onHandleWrite, invocationObserver: null }). Do not call runSupervisedBackendWork (READY BB-100 omits recoveryDir and requiredFiles). Backend EXHAUSTED or TOOL_UNAVAILABLE returns that DeliverSliceStatus with qa null and backendSha null. Only AgentTaskStatus.ACCEPTED with 40-hex acceptedSha proceeds to QA.

D3 — Independent QA: createLocalGitWorkspace({ repositoryRoot, baseRevision: acceptedSha, worktreeRoot: mkdtemp }) then runSliceQa({ workspaceRoot, acceptedSha, qaVerifications }) via createLocalCommandVerifier({ name, claim: `qa.${name}`, root: workspaceRoot, command, args, timeoutMs, requireUnchangedTree: true }).verify({ candidate: { id: slice.id, version: acceptedSha } }). TREE_MUTATED or REVISION_MISMATCH or non-PASS → DeliverSliceStatus.QA_FAILED with backendSha recorded. All QA PASS → ACCEPTED. Dispose the QA worktree in finally. Do not reuse the Backend worktree.

D4 — recoveryDir (CLI --recovery-dir overrides manifest). No handle.json: runSupervisedTask({ recoveryDir }). Handle status RUNNING: resumeSupervisedTask then QA. ACCEPTED: do not call resumeSupervisedTask (HANDLE_COMPLETE); QA on handle.candidateSha. EXHAUSTED/TOOL_UNAVAILABLE: return that status, no QA. crash-deliver-slice.mjs calls runDeliverSlice with onHandleWrite process.exit(97) on phase ACT_COMPLETED attemptIndex 1; parent deliver with the same recoveryDir must ACCEPTED and keep the same backendSha. disposeRecoverableRun after a terminal slice. invocationObserver stays default-null.
D5 — requiredFiles is optional pass-through onto AGENT_TASK when non-empty. Tests omit it. BB-102 owns resolution.

D6 — Every result includes claimBoundary: LOCAL_COMPOSITION_SLICE_NOT_BB069_NOT_BB074 (export LOCAL_SLICE_CLAIM_BOUNDARY). DeliverSliceStatus = ACCEPTED|QA_FAILED|EXHAUSTED|TOOL_UNAVAILABLE. Missing executable: commandDeliver returns TOOL_UNAVAILABLE, reason NOT_INSTALLED, never ACCEPTED, exit 2. CLI exit 0 only for ACCEPTED; 1 for QA_FAILED/EXHAUSTED; 64 for usage.

D7 — Evidence: executed deliver-slice-probe (no deliver command; TREE_MUTATED/REVISION_MISMATCH; acceptedSha checkoutable; composition.js does not import agent-tools; BB-100 omits requiredFiles/recoveryDir; BB-101 HANDLE_COMPLETE). Fake CLI packages/agent-tools/test/fixtures/fake-agent.mjs. Scope tests import auditPaths from test/scope-audit.mjs and do not edit it.

D8 — Living: docs/living/system/agent-tools/operator.md (deliver command, QA binding, resume, missing-tool, local-composition trust boundary as not first-slice product-value and not a controlled-benchmark pilot) plus a pointer in state.md and README. Living docs contain no Blackboard ids; the claim-boundary constant lives on the result object.

D9 — Files: packages/agent-tools/src/deliver-slice.js exports DELIVER_SLICE_VERSION, LOCAL_SLICE_CLAIM_BOUNDARY, DeliverSliceStatus, validateDeliverSlice, runSliceQa, runDeliverSlice, commandDeliver; index.js re-exports them; bin adds deliver; tests deliver-slice.test.js; fixture crash-deliver-slice.mjs. Do not edit supervisor.js.
